request.style: English, male voice with gravelly texture, solo with acoustic guitar, steel guitar, fiddle, and soft drum kit, melancholic yet hopeful, 75 BPM
request.lyrics:
[Verse]
I remember the days of old
Meditating on what you have done
Pondering the work of your hands
Stretching out to you in the sun
My soul thirsts for you so deep
Like a parched land with no sleep

[Pre-Chorus]
Answer me quickly, Lord, I pray
My spirit is spent away
Do not hide your face from me
Or I will fall into the pit

[Chorus]
Let me hear of your steadfast love
In the morning, let it move
For I trust in you alone
Show me the way I should walk
To you I lift up my soul

[Verse]
Deliver me from my enemies
To you I flee for cover
Teach me to do your will
For you are my God, my shelter
Let your good Spirit lead
Me on level ground, indeed

[Chorus]
Let me hear of your steadfast love
In the morning, let it move
For I trust in you alone
Show me the way I should walk
To you I lift up my soul

[Bridge]
For your name's sake, Lord, preserve
My life, in your righteousness
Bring me out of trouble now
Your grace is my only peace

[Chorus]
Let me hear of your steadfast love
In the morning, let it move
For I trust in you alone
Show me the way I should walk
To you I lift up my soul

[Outro]
Steadfast love in the morning
I trust in you
